decisions.reason: The optional SDA/SCL series-resistor policy and revised cable-length assumption do not change the established interboard connector partition, types, pinout, or pin-order policy.
The source changes I2C signal conditioning, not the sensor board's role as a connector fanout.
The I2C series-resistor decision does not alter the standalone USB supply, rail coverage, regulator, or source-selection behavior.
The 22-ohm SDA/SCL resistors are unrelated to the charge-status LED interface and its 270-ohm resistors.
Permission to omit I2C series resistors if they impede layout does not necessarily change connector placement, orientation, accessibility, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source retains the 3.3V I2C pull-up behavior and does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or powered loads.
The I2C signal-conditioning decision does not affect the 5V boost converter, enable control, pull-down, or powered loads.
Although SDA and SCL are mentioned, the source changes only their passive signal conditioning and does not reassign any ESP32-S3 GPIO.
The source does not change addressable-LED power, data GPIO, level shifting, or standby control.
The I2C resistor and cable discussion does not affect the eight-LED daughterboard's count, type, or form.
The source concerns SDA/SCL conditioning and has no effect on native USB D+ and D- connectivity.
The I2C signal-conditioning policy does not change USB-C connector selection, compatibility, or availability requirements.
